root_cause: The daily no-gap fallback randomized over prior personal artifacts but did not exclude source content_ids already used on earlier days. Minor rewrites changed final text hashes, allowing the same underlying printer story to recur.
prevention: Deduplicate personal LinkedIn fallback selection at source content_id level before generation.
Do not treat a rewritten text hash as a new personal-life source.
A used source remains ineligible for later no-gap fallback runs.
